从入学说明会到毕业谢恩会，跟着留学生リン走完四年：交朋友、请教老师、社团、发表与: From freshman orientation to the graduation thank-you party, follow international student Lin through four years of university: making friends, asking professors for help, clubs, presentations, and a thesis. Along the way, learn how to earn people's trust at a Japanese university.
从朋友聚会上认识到求婚：跟着留学生浩和美咲，学恋爱中的日语、分寸和真心。: From meeting at a friend's party to the proposal: follow international student Hao and Misaki, and learn the Japanese of romance, how to read the boundaries, and how to speak from the heart.
跟着留学生リン在便利店打工两年：从打电话约面试到辞职告别，学接客敬语，也读懂严格: Spend two years working part-time at a convenience store with international student Lin, from calling to set up an interview to quitting and saying goodbye. Learn customer-service keigo, and come to understand the kindness behind a strict store manager.
打电话约面试: Calling to set up an interview
跟着新员工王さん走过入职头两年：自我介绍、报连相、接电话、见客户、开会、道歉、聚: Follow new employee Wang through his first two years at the company: self-introductions, 「報連相」 (reporting, informing, and consulting), answering the phone, meeting clients, meetings, apologies, after-work drinks, performance reviews, and farewells.
入职第一天的自我介绍: Introducing yourself on your first day
跟着山田商事营业部的王さん，练接电话、拜访客户、开会、报联商、处理投诉、谈判、面: Join Wang from the sales department at Yamada Shoji and practice business situations such as answering the phone, visiting clients, meetings, 「報連相」 (reporting, informing, and consulting), handling complaints, negotiating, job interviews, and entertaining clients.
早会上的自我介绍: Introducing yourself at the morning meeting
跟着中国留学生チェン，从落地机场到毕业致辞，学会区役所、租房、医院、入管等真实场: Follow Chen, an international student from China, from landing at the airport to his graduation speech, and learn natural Japanese for real situations like the ward office, renting an apartment, the doctor's office, and the immigration bureau.
到达机场入境: Arriving at the airport and going through immigration
从超市、干洗店、药妆店到邮局、理发店和邻里往来，学会在日本踏实过日子的说法和人情: From the supermarket, dry cleaner, and drugstore to the post office, hair salon, and getting along with neighbors, learn the expressions and the human touch you need to settle into everyday life in Japan.
超市找东西和结账: Finding items and checking out at the supermarket
从拉面食券机到居酒屋干杯，以客人的身份在日本点菜、订座、说明过敏、结账和道谢，吃: From the meal ticket machine at a ramen shop to a toast at an izakaya, learn to order, reserve a table, explain allergies, pay, and say thank you as a customer in Japan, so you can enjoy your meal and always say the right thing.
拉面店的食券机: The meal ticket machine at a ramen shop
跟着在东京工作的ヤン和朋友美咲去京都、城崎温泉：坐新干线、住旅馆、找失物、遇台风: Travel to Kyoto and Kinosaki Onsen with Yang, who works in Tokyo, and her friend Misaki: ride the shinkansen, stay at a ryokan, track down a lost item, and get caught in a typhoon. Learn Japanese for the road that is both polite and warm.
在东京站问路和换乘: Asking the way and changing trains at Tokyo Station
跟着在东京工作的ワン，从药局、牙医到119急救、地震台风、报案和心理咨询，学会遇: Follow Wang, who works in Tokyo, from the pharmacy and the dentist to calling 119, earthquakes and typhoons, reporting a crime to the police, and counseling. Learn to explain things clearly when something goes wrong, and not to be afraid to ask for help.
药局拿处方药: Picking up a prescription at the pharmacy
跟着在东京工作的ヤン，从健身房、羽毛球会、语言交换到祭典、志愿者和婚礼致辞，用日: Follow Yang, who works in Tokyo, from the gym, a badminton club, and language exchange to festivals, volunteering, and a wedding speech, and make true friends in Japanese.
健身房入会和问器械: Joining a gym and asking about the machines
跟着在广岛读博的リュウ，去岛根山里的驾校合宿两周：集合出发、听规矩、第一次摸车、: Join Liu, a PhD student in Hiroshima, for a two-week residential course at a driving school in the mountains of Shimane: meeting up and setting off, hearing the rules, getting behind the wheel for the first time, and chatting with a roommate from Osaka, as you work your way step by step to a driver's license.
车站集合出发: Meeting up at the station and setting off
